x Under-activation (FN)
skills overlooked
x No reasoning trace
opaque decisions

span.p:
System Prompt
Skill Evaluation Protocol:
Phase 1: QUICK SCREEN
--> Gate question
--> Default: NO
Phase 2: EVALUATE
--> Per-skill YES/NO
--> Explicit reasoning
Phase 3: IMPLEMENT
--> Execute with
loaded guidance

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Structured evaluation
reduces FP and FN

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Mitigations
+ Quick Screen gates
irrelevant tasks
+ Explicit per-skill eval
forces consideration
+ Auditable YES/NO
with reasoning
